objective: Explain the frozen detector-unseen endpoint gap by decomposing teacher-coordinate shift, detector-feature OOD, and frozen-model calibration residuals without changing the decision.
decision_rule: The original endpoint remains frozen regardless of this diagnostic. Report calibration shift when rank transfer remains at least 0.80 and oracle mean-centering reduces validation MAE by at least 30% with absolute mean residual at least 0.5. Report feature OOD when at least 25% of validation images exceed the train 95th-percentile Mahalanobis distance.
claim_boundary: Post-validation cache-only failure diagnosis. No new inference, training, threshold change, gate reinterpretation, validation claim, action, or AP claim.
